title: World Robot Olympiad 2022-2026 official dataset-level rubrics
authority_and_limitations: This file transcribes the international season documents preserved in the local WRO archive. A National Organizer may adapt international rules, missions, scoring, robot restrictions, and tournament format; local competitors must use the organizer's local rules.
General Rules govern procedure, run adjudication, rule hierarchy, and ranking. Exact mission points and mutually exclusive scoring states come only from each edition-and-age-group Game Rules.
Official season Q&A can clarify, extend, redefine, or overwrite the archived General Rules and Game Rules; the judging team has the final word at an event.

The listed RoboMission maximum is the printed Season Challenge maximum before any surprise task/rule, extra task, technical-summary points, or International Final extra/day challenge. Such additions can change a run total or overall ranking.

Future Innovators mission documents define the season theme but not numeric judging weights. Numeric criteria are included only for 2024, for which an official General Rules scoring sheet was verified; no other year's weights are inferred.

run.score_time: End-of-run field state; time is stopped and the signed score sheet becomes final.

2022.tiebreak_and_ranking: Local format is set by the National Organizer. A typical ranking uses the best run, then time. International Final ranking uses the sum of the best Day 1 and day-challenge points, then summed time, then the stated challenge/run point and time sequence.
2022.surprise_rule: Announced at opening; may change or extend tasks and add positive or penalty points. It does not count as a regular mission for conditions requiring regular positive mission points.

run.score_time: End-of-run field state; damaged objects do not score unless Game Rules say otherwise.

2023.tiebreak_and_ranking: Local format is set by the National Organizer. A typical ranking uses the best run, then time. International Final ranking uses summed best regular/day-challenge points and time followed by the published run-level tiebreak sequence.
2023.surprise_rule: Announced at opening; may change or extend tasks and add positive or penalty points. It is separate from regular missions.

run.score_time: Judge scores the field state at the end of the run against the initial randomization.

2024.tiebreak_and_ranking: Local format is set by the National Organizer. A typical ranking uses the best run, then time. International Final ranking combines best regular and second-day challenge results with the published points/time sequence.
2024.surprise_rule: Announced at opening; may change or extend tasks and add positive or penalty points. It is treated as bonus, not a regular mission. The Game Rules also announce an International Final extra mission.

2025.version: January 15, 2025 (archived document labels itself Draft Version)

run.score_time: Judge scores the end-of-run field state against the initial randomization; time is recorded in full seconds.

2025.tiebreak_and_ranking: National Organizer selects the format. Typical season-only ranking compares best-run points then time and subsequent runs. International Final combines best Season Challenge and Extra-Day-Challenge points, then summed time, then the published challenge/run sequence.
2025.surprise_rule: A Surprise Task may add an object and points; a Surprise Rule may change the Season Challenge. National Organizers select competition elements. Technical-summary points may add up to 5 locally, but are excluded from Game Rules maxima.

run.score_time: Judge scores the end-of-run field state against the initial randomization; time is recorded in full seconds.

2026.tiebreak_and_ranking: National Organizer assembles the format. Typical season-only ranking compares best-run points then time and subsequent runs. International Final combines best Season Challenge and Extra-Day-Challenge points, then summed time, then the published challenge/run sequence.
2026.surprise_rule: A Surprise Task may add points; a Surprise Rule may alter the Season Challenge. Technical-summary points may add up to 5 locally and International Final late submission can cause percentage deductions; neither changes the printed Game Rules maximum.

numeric_rubric.reason: The archived source is the official Mission text; no applicable official General Rules judging sheet was verified locally.
